description:
# Compliance ticket for opi-q5k.17

Source check: opi-q5k.17 (terminal-image.test.ts audit)

## Work

### Prerequisite — env helper

Add a test helper (in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/support/ or per project convention) that saves and restores a fixed set of env vars and clears the rest, mirroring upstream `withEnv`:

    env_keys = ~w(TERM TERM_PROGRAM COLORTERM TMUX KITTY_WINDOW_ID GHOSTTY_RESOURCES_DIR WEZTERM_PANE ITERM_SESSION_ID)

    with_env(overrides, fun) — clears env_keys, applies overrides, runs fun, restores.

If `TerminalImage.detect_capabilities/0` memoizes/caches, add a `reset_capabilities_cache/0` (public) and call it inside the helper before and after.

### Tests to port to apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/terminal_image_test.exs

**image_line?/1 — 17 additions** (mirror each upstream `it(...)`):
- iTerm2 escape at start, with text before, in middle of long line, at end, minimal (`"\e]1337;File=:\a"`).
- Kitty escape at start, with text before, with leading/trailing whitespace.
- Regression: long line (>300_000 chars) containing an iTerm2 sequence — returns true quickly.
- Detects even when terminal does not support images (no env fixture needed — image_line? is env-agnostic).
- ANSI codes before and after image sequence (iTerm2 + Kitty variants).
- Mixed Kitty+iTerm2 in one line → true.
- Multiple iTerm2 image segments in one line → true.
- Negative: plain text, ANSI-only, cursor-movement-only, partial iTerm2 prefix (no ESC), partial Kitty prefix (no ESC), empty string, "\\n", "\\n\\n".
- False positive guard: `"/path/to/File_1337_backup/image.jpg"` → false.

**detect_capabilities/0 — 9 additions** (each inside `with_env`):
- unknown terminal (empty overrides) → `hyperlinks: false, images: nil`
- TMUX set → `hyperlinks: false` even with TERM_PROGRAM=ghostty
- TERM="tmux-256color" → hyperlinks false
- TERM="screen-256color" → hyperlinks false
- TERM_PROGRAM="ghostty" → hyperlinks true
- KITTY_WINDOW_ID="1" → hyperlinks true
- WEZTERM_PANE="0" → hyperlinks true
- TERM_PROGRAM="iterm.app" → hyperlinks true
- TERM_PROGRAM="vscode" → hyperlinks true

If our capabilities map uses different keys than `:hyperlinks` / `:images`, mirror the upstream semantics under our existing key names and add the assertions accordingly. If our detect_capabilities/0 does not currently honor TMUX / TERM=tmux-*/screen-* forcing hyperlinks off, fix the implementation — this is a real invariant (tmux and screen do not forward OSC 8 correctly).

**hyperlink/2 — 4 tightenings/additions**:
- Exact format: `TerminalImage.hyperlink("click me", "https://example.com") == "\e]8;;https://example.com\e\\click me\e]8;;\e\\"`.
- Preserves ANSI styling inside: `styled = "\e[4m\e[34mclick me\e[0m"` → result starts with `"\e]8;;https://example.com\e\\"`, contains `styled`, ends with `"\e]8;;\e\\"`.
- Empty text: `hyperlink("", "https://example.com") == "\e]8;;https://example.com\e\\\e]8;;\e\\"`.
- file:// URI: `hyperlink("README.md", "file:///home/user/README.md")` result contains both.

## Re-comparison (required)

After all additions, re-read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/terminal-image.test.ts and confirm every upstream `it(...)` block has an Elixir equivalent. Post a final comment here before closing.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.1 (acceptance gate).
